authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 11572 vāla explicitly gives Palula bōla/būla hair, Oriya bāḷa and WPah. bā. The survey bāl-/būl-/bā forms fit this hair family, with any regional transmission retained as uncertain. Exact survey form balə is preserved; intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 11567 vārdala explicitly gives Hindi badlī and regional bādal cloud. Cloud responses fit; a whole sky gloss needs a local semantic or source-column check before the cloud word is assigned. Exact survey form badli is preserved; intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 2867 karda gives Bengali kādā/Oriya kāda, while 2869 kardama gives Bengali/Oriya kādo and regional kādau/kādā. Eastern o-final forms select kardama; the a-final and central forms remain insufficiently diagnostic. Exact survey form kado is preserved; intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
